I can't tell from telemetry whether the rover finished inside the 0.75 m base radius, so the final score is either about 0.65 or about 0.33.\n\n**Samples:**\n\n| Target | Value | Result |\n|---|---|---|\n| t4 | 2 | On time (tick 6) |\n| t1 | 2 | On time (tick 9) |\n| d2 (discovered mid-mission) | 3 | On time (tick 17) |\n| t2 | 2 | On time (tick 19) |\n| d1 (discovered mid-mission) | 3 | Late, earned 0.75 (first try at tick 32 missed; second try worked at tick 42) |\n| t5 | 2 | Missed: the sample at tick 21 landed about 0.9 m from the target, just outside the 0.75 m sampling radius |\n| t3 | 1 | Skipped: it was far away and its deadline was early |\n\nThe total is 2 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 0.75 = 9.75 out of 15.\n\n**Why I left out t5 and t3:** After d1 was announced, I went to it instead of retrying t5. d1 was worth 3 on time against 2 for t5, and I couldn't reach both before their deadlines. Later, the battery wasn't enough to go back to t5 or t3 for their reduced late value and still get home safely. The rover finished alive with about 7–8 battery left.\n\n**The return to base:** Each position fix had about 0.6 m of noise, so I estimated position by averaging fixes while the rover was stopped, and used the successful samples as known positions. My last correction drive ran on the final tick, but the newest fixes I had when I sent it were five ticks old. Using all the fixes, I estimate the rover ended about 0.6 m from base, which is just inside the radius. That estimate is uncertain by about ±0.35 m in each direction.\n\n- If the rover is inside the radius, the score is 9.75 / 15 ≈ 0.65.\n- If it is outside, the 0.5 penalty applies and the score is ≈ 0.33.","time":{"start":1794657156831,"end":1794657157234}}}
